id: 07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario
title: 实验室安全基础：应急程序与报告情景
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/07_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Emergency Procedures and Reporting Scenario/src.py

points.K1: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
points.K2: 这样的未遂要不要报告
points.K3: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一只有小破洞的蓝手套，向镜头歪头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blue nitrile glove with a tiny hole and tilts its head at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课是个情景题：手套破了怎么办？

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个大问号牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big question mark sign and tilts its head.
shots.narration: 听完故事，请你一起来想答案。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 实验台上放着培养皿和粉色试管架
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench with culture dishes and a pink test tube rack, softly lit. No people.
shots.narration: 实验台上，摆着培养皿和试管架。
overlay: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 阿杰戴蓝色丁腈手套，坐在台前准备注射器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a lab coat, goggles and blue nitrile gloves sits at the bench preparing a syringe.
shots.narration: 一位研究人员正在做实验。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 阿杰右手拿着装红色液体的注射器，针尖靠近左手
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the young male student's blue-gloved hands: the right hand holds a syringe filled with red liquid, the needle tip close to the left hand.
shots.narration: 他手里拿着一支皮下注射器。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 针尖擦过左手手套，手套上出现一个小破口
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the needle tip grazing the left blue glove, leaving a tiny tear in the glove.
shots.narration: 一不小心，针头刺破了手套。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 阿杰停下来看手指，皮肤完好
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses and looks at his finger through the torn glove; the skin underneath is unharmed.
shots.narration: 还好，皮肤没有受伤。

shots.section_title: 针头刺破手套，皮肤没伤
shots.scene: 阿杰松了口气，拍拍胸口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lets out a sigh of relief and pats his chest.
shots.narration: 这是一起没有造成伤害的未遂事件。

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰看看四周，实验室里很安静
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances around the quiet laboratory, unsure what to do.
shots.narration: 问题来了：没受伤，
overlay: 这样的未遂要不要报告

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰头顶浮现一个对话气泡，里面是问号
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble with a question mark floats above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 把这件事告诉别人，重要吗？

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 破手套图标和对话气泡图标之间一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: A torn glove icon and a speech bubble icon with a large question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 这起未遂事件，要不要说出来？

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头，竖起一根手指放在嘴边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot faces the camera and puts one finger to its lips, as if asking for quiet thinking.
shots.narration: 先别急着往下看，停下来想一想。

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 画面渐暗，只留一个沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The screen slowly dims, leaving only an hourglass icon with falling sand in the center. No people.
shots.narration: 给自己一点时间，好好想想。

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白本子上写写画画
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot writes in a blank notebook, thinking hard.
shots.narration: 写下你的答案，还有你的理由。

shots.section_title: 这样的未遂要不要报告
shots.scene: 阿杰托着下巴，认真思考
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rests his chin on his hand, thinking seriously.
shots.narration: 如果是你，你会怎么做？

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 本课面向实验室人员，
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 规程手册放大，旁边一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank procedure binder with a large green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不能代替你实验室自己的规程。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现注射器和破手套图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a syringe and a torn glove.
shots.narration: 针头刺破了手套，

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 完好的手指图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unharmed finger with a small sparkle. No people.
shots.narration: 皮肤没有受伤。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 一个对话气泡和问号图标
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble icon with a question mark inside. No people.
shots.narration: 这样的未遂，告诉别人重要吗？

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头眨眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot winks at the camera with a friendly smile.
shots.narration: 这道题，留给你自己找答案。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣把破手套举向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds the torn glove out toward the camera.
shots.narration: 想好答案了吗？记在心里。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰看着手上的破手套，望向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the torn glove on his hand, then looks at the camera thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 下一次，你会怎么做？

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在实验台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside the lab bench.
shots.narration: 带着问题去思考，下次见！
